**Author**: Erik Broekhuizen
**Published Date**: 2019-01-01

**Coverage**: Full PDF archived locally under reports/poten/pdfs/2019/Weekly-Opinion-23-January-2019-Coronavirus-Concerns.pdf. Analysis & Overview
Coronavirus Concerns
23 Jan 2020: The coronavirus outbreak, which started in the city of Wuhan in China, has spread across several countries in Asia, with confirmed cases in South Korea, Japan, Taiwan as well as Thailand and Singapore. There has also been one case identified in the United States.
